periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation slanting inward and downward towards the muzzle at approximately 45 degrees from the horizontal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/tear-drop morphology with a vertical axis significantly exceeding the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending well below the geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary visible across the upper shoulder region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering approximately 35-40% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the white cranial surface, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded convex apex without flattened or irregular surfaces.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cream/yellowish discoloration of the ventral fur compared to the stark white of the cranial region.
